text:
Nina Park: quick heads-up  final onsite candidate (Jordan K.) is doing a cross-office loop today (NY office for morning, then transit to Jersey campus for afternoon). Need coordinated logistics, EV charging for their rental, and a secure locker for a medical infusion pump during interviews.
Carlos M.: travel window? how long between offices?
Nina Park: landing 7:15am, NY interviews 8:300:45am, leaving ~11:00am to Jersey; expects to arrive Jersey ~12:00pm. We booked Amtrak + car share for inter-office leg.
Facilities: EV charger note: which charging level? Level 2 chargers on-site available but need permit. We can reserve a spot at Jersey campus. Plate number needed by noon.
Nina Park: candidate will rent an EV via rental company, plate TBD; I'll request plate when they confirm. Can we reserve a Level 2 charger for ~11:50am-4:00pm?
Facilities: reserving Level 2 stall for 11:45am-4:15pm. We'll add an EV hangtag and set charging access. Please provide plate by 10am day-of.
Carmen Li: medical device note: candidate has a portable infusion pump that needs refrigeration and locked storage during technical interviews. Are we able to provide a secure fridge/locker?
Security: we can provide a small locked refrigerator in the nurse/first-aid room and a keyed locker in Security office. Need medical note or confirmation and escort policy.
Legal: quick flag  candidate asked about signing a light NDA for a brief architecture walkthrough at Jersey site. We need to provide a one-page candidate NDA (short form) and get approval before interview.
Nina Park: can Legal draft a short NDA and send to candidate via secure DocuSign? Candidate prefers to sign before arriving at Jersey.
Legal: yes. We'll draft a short one-page Candidate Visit NDA and route to Nina for signature. Expect draft in ~30m. Note: no background-sensitive IP should be discussed until NDA signed.
Reception: after-hours? both sites are open during day. For Jersey pickup, advise candidate to check in at Delivery Gate B and text "Jordan K - Jersey Arrived" to +1-555-222-1100. We'll have Security escort from Gate to Conf Hall.
Travel Desk: train + car-share booked. Amtrak 11:02 departure, car-share reserved for 11:50 pickup at NY station (will do EV handoff). Added buffer for delays.
People Ops Bot: Reminder: expense/reimbursement template: "Expense Type: Candidate Travel; Amount: $XX; Candidate: Jordan K.; Approver: Nina Park". If rental EV charged personal card, reimburse per policy.
Carmen Li: refrigeration: I'll coordinate nurse station to reserve small medical fridge and set to locked-only access. Candidate should be able to retrieve every 2-3 hours. Security will hold a locker key.
Security: Escort confirmed for Jersey: Officer B. James will meet at Gate B at arrival and escort candidate to Conf Hall and the nurse station. We'll hold a keyed locker #12; key with Officer James.
Nina Park: can we provide a quiet private room during infusion times? Candidate said they may need a 100 minute break every 2 hours.
Facilities: Conf Room J1 reserved as a quiet prep/rest room 11:55am-3:30pm. We'll set "Do Not Disturb" signage during breaks.
Carlos M.: panelists  confirm whether you need remote backup for Jersey segment if candidate has medical delay >30m? Zoom fallback created.
Carmen Li: also requesting candidate medical authorization note: ask candidate to upload brief physician note to secure HR upload link; do not send over Slack.
Nina Park: already requested secure upload link; candidate will upload the note and rental plate later today.
Legal: NDA drafted and routed to Nina. Use DocuSign for signature; candidate can sign prior to Jersey arrival. Once signed, we can proceed with architecture walkthrough.
Travel Desk: EV rental note: if candidate wants charging paid by Redwood, please confirm and we'll add to hotel/hotel folio or bill to travel vendor. Approve up to $40 charging fee per site.
Nina Park: approve up to $40 charging fee. If candidate pays, reimburse on receipt to expenses@redwood.ai subject "Candidate EV Charge - Jordan K. - [date]".
Reception: NY site check-in: candidate to text "Jordan K - NY Arrived" to +1-555-111-0001 for fast badge. We'll have an escort to subway/Amtrak platform at 11:00am.
Security: note for lockers/refrigerator: staff will sanitize before/after use. Candidate may keep pump in the fridge between sessions; retrieval only permitted with escort.
Carmen Li: dietary: candidate is allergic to sesame; kitchen to prepare boxed lunch GF + sesame-free for Jersey segment.
Facilities: EV charging stall signage printed; will leave a laminated map in the travel folder and an EV cable locker if needed.
Nina Park: logistics checklist for candidate DM: meet spot NY lobby, badge phone numbers for both sites, DocuSign NDA link, secure upload link for medical note, plate request, and reimbursement instructions. I'll DM now.
Carlos M.: I'll be panel lead in Jersey; will confirm panel presence and whether they need remote backup.
People Ops Bot: This thread will auto-archive in 7 days per channel retention policy.
Nina Park: closing the loop  please ping here instantly if any of the docs (NDA, medical note, plate) are missing day-of. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
